conservative_opening_relation.cross_check: reproduces Round 75's 7,920 orbit-changing pairs and uniform out-degree 55 exactly
conservative_opening_relation.definition: q -> r iff there exist a phase f in {0..4}, a rotation-run length l in {0..5} and a non-rotation joint a in {w2:10,w3:120,w3:201,w3:210} with word_after(sigma^l(port(q,f)), a) a port of r
conservative_opening_relation.exclusion_justification: an excluded (q,r) means r appears nowhere in the 120-element target multiset of q under the full macro generator set; this is exhaustion over the fixed group action, independent of visitation, resources and history
conservative_opening_relation.no_weight2_exclusion: a weight-2 joint into a fresh orbit is a legal engine transition -- extend() computes abandonment and new_orbit independently and gates neither -- so w2:10 stays in the joint set even though at l=5 it is the orbit-preserving E^1
conservative_opening_relation.over_approximation_proof: a genuine opening of r from q is a macro edge from the walk's endpoint in q: l rotations then one joint landing in r. The engine imposes strictly more conditions -- every rotation target unvisited, the joint target unvisited, the child surviving area_a_prune_reason, and one specific endpoint phase. All are dropped here and the phase is existentially quantified over all five, which in particular permits arbitrary legal E^1 closure beforehand. Dropping conditions only adds edges.

round_81_cover_order.do_not_do: no stronger exclusion was invented to manufacture payoff; every edge the relation omits is omitted by exhaustion over the fixed group action, not by absence from a search

negative_structural_result.statement: static incidence + orbit-level ordering is exhausted: every one of the 6,657 residual states admits a cover-compatible final orbit set that is entirely reachable under a maximally conservative opening relation
negative_structural_result.the_decisive_obstacle: phase. The phase-refined relation has uniform out-degree 17, not 55, and a walk pinned to one (orbit,phase) could open at most 17 candidates -- often as few as 5, and as few as 0 from the worst open phase. That is a factor of roughly 3.2 of unused restriction. It is unusable because E^1 moves the phase for free, so the conservative relation must quantify over all five phases.

blocked_w2_lemma.proof: A window becomes visited in exactly three ways: as a joint target (weight >= 2, hence REGISTERED), as the initial endpoint (registered), or as a rotation target. A rotation reaches blocker = sigma(p') only from p'. By the no-repeat rule p' is visited exactly once, and that visit is the current one at the end of the current rotation run, which has not gone past p'. So a visited blocker cannot have been rotation-visited, hence it is registered. The blocker is a port of the target's orbit, so that orbit already holds a registered port and new_orbit is False. At ell = 5 the blocker is p itself -- the pass entry, a joint target -- which is also why E^1 preserves the orbit. QED

round_84_z3_generation.generation_necessity_proof: Every orbit of S must be opened fresh, and with F = 1 every fresh opening is a Z3 (Round 83). A Z3 opening of r is a macro edge departing the walk's current orbit, which at that moment is in A union the already-opened members of S. So the openings admit an order s_1..s_K in which each s_i has a Z3 predecessor in A union {s_1..s_{i-1}}. Conversely such an order is exactly a witness that every element of S is reachable from A inside the induced graph G[A u S] -- the greedy closure of A within A u S reaches all of S iff such an order exists. Reachability in the FULL graph is strictly weaker, since a path may pass through an orbit not selected into S.

stage_A_phase_labelled_table.ell5_joint_geometry: ell = 5 에서 w3:120 은 720/720 전부 같은 궤도(E^2)이고 w3:201 과 w3:210 은 720/720 전부 다른 궤도. 따라서 G5_phase 의 out-degree 는 정확히 2.

stage_B_post_open_endpoint.statement: Z3 opening 직후 엔진의 새 endpoint 는 joint target 그 자체이고, 착지 port 가 곧 등록 port 이며 현재 위상은 착지 위상과 동일하다. 진입 직후에는 위상 자유도가 전혀 없다.

stage_C_local_phase_closure.conclusion: 국소 수리 폐포 = 5개 위상 전체. 위상 정보는 완전히 소실되고 관계는 궤도 수준 자유도로 붕괴한다.
stage_C_local_phase_closure.cost: E^1 은 dNdef = dPhi = dO = dF = 0 이며 P 를 1 소비할 뿐이다. 최종 25궤도 x 5 port 중 121개가 등록되므로 궤도당 평균 4.84 port 가 등록된다 -- 즉 궤도 안에서 위상을 옮기는 것은 정상적인 진행이지 사치가 아니다.
stage_C_local_phase_closure.legality: E^1 은 ell = 5 (현재 육각형이 endpoint 만 방문) 와 target 미방문을 요구한다. 라운드 85 보조정리에 의해 미래의 모든 pass 는 fresh 육각형에 진입하므로 ell = 5 조건은 자동으로 만족되고, target 미방문은 과대근사(건전성 요구)에 의해 참으로 간주해야 한다.
stage_C_local_phase_closure.statement: ell = 5 의 같은 궤도 이동은 정확히 둘뿐이다. E^1 (w2:10) 은 720/720 에서 위상 +1, E^2 (w3:120) 은 720/720 에서 위상 +2. E^1 하나만으로 5-주기 전체가 생성된다.

round_86_phase_chain.structural_diagnosis: 위상만으로는 부족하고 어느 port 가 방문됐는지에 대한 전역 occupancy 가 있어야 E^1 을 막을 수 있다. 그러나 천장 측정이 보여주듯 그것을 넣더라도 이 조합에서는 18개(0.27%)가 상한이므로, 전역 occupancy 추적은 이 방향에서는 정당화되지 않는다.
round_86_phase_chain.why_zero: E^1 이 위상을 무료로 옮긴다. 착지 위상은 정확히 결정되지만(2단계에서 확인) 그 직후 E^1 사슬이 5개 위상 전체를 복구하므로, 건전한 과대근사에서는 위상 상관이 남지 않는다. 이는 라운드 82의 결론과 같은 벽이며, 이번에는 다단계 연쇄 수준에서 재확인된 것이다.

vnts_lemma.cross_hexagon_use: h82's own occupancy is irrelevant (mostly empty, histogram {0:81,2:1,4:1,63:1}); the obstruction comes from hexagon 40 being full, a different hexagon from the target's own
engine_universal_assumptions: unique weight-2 move, bijective action -> unique predecessor per target
vnts_lemma.full_hex_corollary: if an entire hexagon is full and no anchor's endpoint lies in it, VNTS applies to all six windows simultaneously
vnts_lemma.name: Visited Non-Terminal Source (VNTS)
per_anchor_assumptions: H1: sigma visited at every anchor
H2: no anchor terminal at sigma
vnts_lemma.statement: Let tau be a literal window targeted by the engine's unique weight-2 move, sigma its unique weight-2 predecessor, A a finite anchor family. If (H1) sigma visited at every anchor and (H2) no anchor's endpoint equals sigma, then no exact descendant of A can ever be at sigma, so the move into tau can never fire in any descendant.
vnts_lemma.unresolved_generalization: hub-hexagon-set engine-universality is explicitly left open; no branch other than short_ell2_r1_37 has attempted the 7-item certificate checklist
vnts_lemma.why_h82_not_a_fullness_obstruction: VNTS never requires the target's own hexagon to be full, only that some hexagon (wherever the predecessor lives) is full-and-non-terminal
